# Commander documentation

Source: https://github.com/PStarH/Commander
Documentation: https://pstarh.github.io/commander-docs/

Commander is alpha. Current enterprise evaluation: historical Shadow Phase A,
https://github.com/PStarH/Commander/blob/codex/release-20260810/docs/pilot/shadow/README.md
This path does not execute or authorize external actions. Live Kubernetes rollback is frozen.

Read the public pages in this order: quick start, deployment, operations,
security, SDKs, benchmarks, then support and limits. Do not infer production
multi-tenant readiness, compliance certification, or production SLO attainment
from benchmark or CI material.
